title.purpose: Section, card, group and modal-level headings.

body.purpose: Running UI prose; 600-weight for button/tab/chip/field labels.

label.purpose: Dates, counters and short time-coded eyebrows — never prose.

shadows.name: ticket
shadows.purpose: Composer card and month sheet — rectangular paper containers lifting off the velvet.

shadows.name: ticket-drop
shadows.purpose: Applied to .ticket-wrap (filter, not box-shadow) because the ticket itself is CSS-masked and would clip a box-shadow.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: The one floating overlay in the system; deliberately the heaviest shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring on paper fields, paired with a border color shift to Stamp Ink; a focus cue, not a depth cue.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions and the stamp-press/settle keyframes.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: 520ms var(--ease-out), keyframes rotate(-9deg) scale(1.45) opacity(0) blur(2px) -> rotate(-2deg) scale(0.94) -> rotate(-3deg) scale(1)
motion.purpose: New-ticket stamp entrance; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ticket-settle
motion.purpose: New-ticket wrapper drop-in, paired with stamp-press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default submit action inside a paper context (e.g. "Add date").
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: #3b3a97; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem/1.2 'Figtree', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary .ds-icon { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2e2d80; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b3a97; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rose Button

components.name: Ghost Button (on lining)
components.description: Secondary action on the velvet ground (e.g. settings toggle, "Not now").
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid #6a2a3d; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #f7eee3; font: 600 1rem/1.2 'Figtree', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #4d1728; border-color: #8a4458; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eba6b1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper-ground text/date/time input; forces color-scheme: light so native pickers stay on the paper palette.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #2a1d23; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #c9b59c; border-radius: 9px; background: #fffaf3; color: #2a1d23; font: 400 1rem/1.3 'Figtree', sans-serif; color-scheme: light; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b7780; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #a8927a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3b3a97; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,58,151,0.25); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: List/Month view switch; pill track with a paper-filled active segment.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.2rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #4d1728; } .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #dcc2c9; font: 600 0.875rem 'Figtree', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg:hover { color: #f7eee3; } .ds-seg.is-active { background: #f7efe4; color: #2a1d23; }

components.css: .ds-ticket { --notch: 0.5rem; --stub: 5.25rem; position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--stub) minmax(0,1fr); min-height: 5.5rem; background: #f7efe4; color: #2a1d23; border-radius: 9px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(20,4,9,0.35)) drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(20,4,9,0.45)); mask: radial-gradient(circle at var(--stub) 0, #0000 var(--notch), #000 calc(var(--notch) + 0.5px)) top / 100% 51% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle at var(--stub) 100%, #0000 var(--notch), #000 calc(var(--notch) + 0.5px)) bottom / 100% 51% no-repeat; } .ds-ticket-stub { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0.6rem 0.4rem; border-right: 1.5px dashed #d9c8b2; } .ds-stamp { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.1rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem 0.35rem; min-width: 3.6rem; border: 2px solid #9b2743; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #f7efe4, inset 0 0 0 3px #9b2743; color: #9b2743; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-stamp-day { font-size: 1.85rem; } .ds-stamp-month { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-ticket-body { padding: 0.75rem 0.6rem 0.75rem 1rem; } .ds-ticket-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-ticket-meta { margin: 0.3rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #62505a; }

narrative.overview:
Relationship Calendar reads as a couple's dates kept like ticket stubs tucked into a velvet-lined box, not as a form sitting over a list. The page is built from exactly two grounds — a deep claret velvet lining that holds the header, the section chrome and the takeaway panels, and warm paper that every ticket, card and input sits on — and the system never blurs them into a third, in-between surface. Every interactive surface commits to one ground or the other: paper things get the violet-blue ink-stamp accent, velvet things get the rose foil accent, and nothing is shaded halfway to "neutral" gray. The signature device is the ticket itself: a real CSS-mask silhouette with two notch cutouts and a dashed tear line, topped with a rotated rubber-stamp badge in condensed numerals — built with actual geometry, not a texture image standing in for one.

The system refuses faked materiality. There is no paper-grain texture, no drop-shadow doing double duty as "depth," no gradient standing in for velvet nap — the claret ground is two soft radial gradients plus a flat fill, and the "paper" is a flat warm off-white with a slightly different flat off-white for its secondary surface. Depth, where it exists at all, is reserved for the handful of paper set-pieces that need to visually lift off the velvet (the composer card, the month sheet, the ticket, the toast); every button, chip, input and badge is flat at rest. Browser chrome carries the world too: selection, caret, scrollbar track/thumb, and the accent-color of native checkboxes/date pickers are all themed, so the illusion doesn't break at the edges of authored markup.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds, two accents — velvet lining (rose) and paper (violet-blue stamp), never mixed.
The ticket is a real cut silhouette (CSS mask), not an illustrated or textured stand-in.
Flat by default; shadow is reserved for paper set-pieces sitting on velvet.
Barlow Condensed uppercase numerals do the "rubber stamp" work; Figtree stays plain for UI prose.
Pill radius on everything actionable; 14px/9px radius on everything static.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Stamp Ink is the accent for things sitting on paper (buttons, inputs, focus rings, checked states inside the composer and tickets). Rose is the accent for things sitting on velvet (links, primary CTAs, selection, caret). A control never borrows the other ground's accent.

rules.name: The Foil Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Gold appears exactly once, on the day-counter numeral. It does not recur as a button, a border, or a second brand color — its rarity is what makes it read as foil rather than paint.

rules.name: The Stamp Numerals Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed 600 uppercase is reserved for dates, counters and short time-coded labels — never for running prose, button copy or field labels, which stay in Figtree.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadow only appears on paper set-pieces sitting on the velvet ground (card, month-sheet, ticket, toast). Nothing else — not a button, not a chip, not a badge — casts one at rest.

dos: Do use Stamp Ink as the accent for anything sitting on paper, and Rose as the accent for anything sitting on velvet lining — check the ground before picking the accent.
Do build any new ticket-like or stub-like shape with a real CSS mask/clip-path, keyed off a --stub-style custom property, never with a background image or texture.
Do keep new actionable controls fully round (999px) and new static containers on the 9px/14px pair — don't introduce a third radius.
Do reserve Barlow Condensed uppercase for dates, counters and short time-coded labels; keep prose, buttons and field labels in Figtree.
Do provide a forced-colors fallback for any new masked shape (solid CanvasText border, mask dropped).
donts: Don't add a shadow to a button, chip, input or badge at rest — shadow is reserved for the paper set-pieces sitting on velvet (card, month-sheet, ticket, toast).
Don't introduce a gradient, grain, or image standing in for paper or velvet texture — both grounds are flat fills (the lining's two radial gradients are ambient lighting, not material texture).
Don't use icon fonts or glyph icon sets — icons are hand-drawn single-stroke (1.75) SVG symbols sharing one <svg class="sprite"> sheet.
Don't flip color-scheme on the page shell to light to "fix" a form control — the dark shell plus light-forced form fields is the deliberate way native pickers stay legible against paper.
